title: Fix Mcp App Scene Models and Diagram
description:
The compose engine MCP App (ui://compose/design-viewer) shows scene connection lines but no GLTF meshes for pieces, and an empty diagram panel in start_working_in_design.

Root causes identified:
1. `_strip_kit_blobs` strips ALL file blobs and replaces with HTTP URLs → GLB model fetches from localhost are blocked by CSP in the sandboxed iframe
2. Diagram `ComposeDiagram` uses `currentColor` for entity fill which may be invisible in iframe context
3. `_enrich_design` uses `not ep.get("plane")` guard which skips pieces that already have plane/center from serialized data (possibly stale values)

Fixes needed:
1. In `compose/engine/main.py` `_strip_kit_blobs`: keep `.glb`/`.gltf` blobs inline as data URLs (don't strip them)
2. In `compose/ui/index.tsx` `ComposeDiagram`/`buildDiagramSnapshot`: ensure diagram entity colors are explicit, not `currentColor`
3. In `compose/engine/main.py` `_enrich_design`: always overwrite plane/center from flatten result (remove the `not ep.get("plane")` guard)
4. Rebuild `compose/engine/dist/mcp-app.html`
summary:
Fixed two root causes for missing 3D models and empty diagram in the MCP App design viewer:

1. `_strip_kit_blobs` (main.py): GLB/GLTF files now kept inline as data URLs instead of being replaced with HTTP URLs. This eliminates the CSP/HTTP dependency for 3D model loading in the sandboxed iframe — `useGLTF` can now load from data URLs directly.

2. `_enrich_design` (main.py): Removed the `not ep.get("plane")` and `not ep.get("center")` guards. The flatten result from `flattenDesignDict` now ALWAYS overwrites existing plane/center on pieces. Previously, pieces with stored `center: {u:0, v:0}` (truthy non-empty dict) were not overwritten, causing all diagram circles to cluster at the origin.

3. Rebuilt `compose/engine/dist/mcp-app.html` (6.55MB) incorporating all JS debug logs added in prior sessions.

All 174 engine tests pass.
